turns.user: I activated a 90-minute ticket at 14:00 and want to return by tram after my visit.
turns.agent:
Your 90-minute mobile ticket can cover transfers on eligible lines during its 90-minute window. If you make your final transfer before the window ends, you may finish that last ride after the 90 minutes have passed. Validate at the start of the ride and when changing to another line; transfers between metro lines are the exception.

The snapshot says 90-minute mobile tickets cost 850 HUF and require an internet-connected phone. Since yours is already activated at 14:00, the window ends at 15:30. So, for your return tram: if you board it—or make your final transfer to it—before 15:30, you may finish that ride after 15:30. If you start the tram ride or make that transfer after 15:30, this ticket’s time window won’t cover it; you’d need another suitable fare. This is based on the 5 November 2026 snapshot, not live verification.

See BKK’s 90-minute ticket rules. What time do you expect to start the return tram ride?

turns.user: The return tram boards at 15:29 and I get off at 15:52. Is that valid?
turns.agent:
Yes—on the 90-minute mobile ticket, that ride is covered under the snapshot rule, assuming 15:29 is when you board the tram and you validate as required. Your ticket’s 90-minute window ends at 15:30; because the tram ride begins before then, you may finish that final ride at 15:52. This assumes you haven’t already made a later transfer after 15:30.

The 5 November 2026 snapshot says to validate at the start of the ride and when changing lines; the final ride may continue beyond the window if the final transfer happened before it ended. See BKK’s 90-minute ticket rules. This is dated snapshot-based guidance, not live verification.
